One shared world state connects spatial memory, object interventions, and independently chosen camera trajectories.

THE CORE IDEA

A world state you can intervene in.

UniState represents spatial memory and user-specified object motion in a shared coordinate system. The camera can move independently, while the video model generates plausible responses beyond the prescribed transformations.

01 / REPRESENT

Build spatial memory

Lift image features into 3D and incorporate additional views into a unified representation of the scene.

02 / INTERVENE

Specify object motion

Transform a selected object or part directly within the world state, independently of the camera trajectory.

03 / SIMULATE

Generate the consequences

Render the state to condition video generation, allowing additional object motion and interactions with the surroundings.

INTERVENTIONS IN ACTION

One state. Many ways to shape the world.
